scope: Pinned collector/runtime source and build-configuration audit; no performance or blanket semantic-equivalence claim.

facts.allocYoungFalse: Initially promote entire nursery segments into old generation; first old-generation collection resets promotion mode.
facts.initialHeap: Sets old-generation target-size budget minus one fixed nursery segment, affecting the first collection threshold.
facts.maximumHeap: Segment-allocation ceiling, distinct from initial old-generation budget.
facts.youngGenerationSize: Fixed-size segment with adaptive effective end; no supported nursery-size CLI flag was found in the pinned RuntimeFlags.
facts.weakMapScanning: Young-generation evacuation explicitly traverses WeakMap entries as roots.
facts.finiteWindow: Larger initial budgets can postpone the first old-generation collection beyond a finite batch; that does not establish sustained throughput across collection cycles.
